builds.title: Gray Orc wayhouse keeper, Cleric 2
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 3 (2 class HD, LA +1).
traits: Neutral evil. Chain shirt +4, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 14, armor check penalty −2. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +5, Reflex +1, Will +6.
Light Sensitivity (Ex) gives −1 on attack rolls in bright sunlight or within a daylight spell.
Scent (Ex). Detect creatures by smell at 30 ft. in still air, 60 ft. upwind and 15 ft. downwind. Use a move action to determine direction. Pinpoint a scent source within 5 ft.
Cleric of Luthic. Earth domain grants 3 shared uses/day to turn or destroy air creatures or rebuke or command earth creatures. Healing domain adds +1 caster level to Healing spells.
Combat Casting adds +4 to Concentration while casting defensively, grappled, or pinned.
actions: Caster level 2, or 3 for Healing spells. Four orisons, DC 13 when relevant. Detect magic, guidance, light, and resistance.

First level, three slots plus one domain slot, DC 14 when relevant. Bless (+1 morale on attacks and saves against fear for 2 minutes), cure light wounds (1d8+3 healing), shield of faith (+2 deflection AC for 2 minutes), and domain magic stone. Spontaneous inflict spells can replace prepared non-domain spells.
Magic stone enchants up to three pebbles for 30 minutes or until discharged. Thrown stone +3, 1d6+1 bludgeoning or 2d6+2 against undead, 20-ft. range increment.
Rebuke or command undead 3/day. Turning check 1d20, turning damage 2d6+2. Earth domain has its own pool and the same check and damage.
builds.tactics: Maura keeps a lamp ready at the door and checks arriving travelers for injuries. If the wayhouse comes under attack, she casts bless before moving to cover.

builds.title: Gray Orc windward tracker, Ranger 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
traits: Neutral. Studded leather +3, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 13, armor check penalty −1. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +3, Reflex +4, Will +2.
Light Sensitivity (Ex) gives −1 on attack rolls in bright sunlight or within a daylight spell.
Scent (Ex). Detect creatures by smell at 30 ft. in still air, 60 ft. upwind and 15 ft. downwind. Use a move action to determine direction. Pinpoint a scent source within 5 ft.
Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot, already included. Favored enemy animals gives +2 weapon damage and +2 to Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot, and Survival used against animals.
Track is a bonus feat. Wild empathy check 1d20. Magical beasts with Intelligence 1 or 2 impose −4.
actions: Greataxe +4 melee, 1d12+4 slashing, critical ×3. Longbow +3 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical ×3, 100-ft. range increment. Add +2 to damage against animals.
Track by scent with Survival +6, or +8 when tracking animals. Fresh scent trails typically start at DC 10 and rise by 2 per hour.
builds.tactics: Keshen pauses where the trail turns into the wind. He marks the path for the party before moving down to the crossing.

concepts.name: Maura Stonewick
concepts.role: Wayhouse keeper and Cleric of Luthic.
concepts.motive: Keep the shelter open until the night travelers arrive.
concepts.hook: Maura asks for help carrying an injured porter out of the rain.

concepts.name: Keshen Trailmark
concepts.motive: Find a missing pack animal before it reaches the ravine.
concepts.hook: Keshen asks the party to wait while he checks where the trail goes upwind.
